_comment: Config for deploy/New-AuditRetentionPolicy.ps1. Author-only reference data - NOT applied to any tenant unless passed to the deploy script without -DryRun. Defines Microsoft Purview Audit (Premium) audit-log retention policies: how long audit records are kept, scoped by record type / operation / user, with a priority. Placeholder values are illustrative - set them to your real obligations before deploying. Read README.md Sections 2 and 11 first (10-year retention needs the add-on; the default policy can't be modified; max 50 policies/org).

policies.name: Retain Exchange admin audit 10 years
policies.description: Long-retention for privileged Exchange admin operations for regulatory investigations.

policies.name: Retain Entra sign-in audit 1 year
policies.description: Keep Microsoft Entra (Azure AD) sign-in/audit records for 12 months.
